Railway Spring

Railway suspension spring inquiries for bogies and rolling stock, reviewed against spring geometry, load-deflection requirements and the approved vehicle design.

Product overview

Railway springs support the suspension arrangement of a vehicle or bogie. This category focuses on steel coil springs and drawing-based spring inquiries; leaf springs and other spring forms require separate confirmation. The required spring is defined by its function and controlled specification, not by a photograph or nominal outside diameter. A freight load spring, a side spring and a locomotive suspension spring must not be treated as interchangeable parts.

Application and configuration

Identify the bogie type, spring position and whether the order is for individual springs or a matched assembly. Where concentric springs are used, provide the approved inner and outer spring arrangement and the required set composition. Any change to spring stiffness, installed height or quantity requires review by the vehicle's responsible engineering authority.

Technical information for quotation

Project-specific information to confirm
ConfigurationCoil or other specified form; individual spring or matched group
GeometryBar diameter, outside diameter, free height, coil count and end form
Functional dataLoad at specified heights, stiffness range and agreed tolerances
MaterialGrade, heat-treatment condition, surface protection and marking
InstallationSpring seat geometry, installed space and applicable assembly drawing

Manufacturing and supply review

A proposed production route for a coil spring may include material identification, winding, heat treatment, end preparation, any specified surface treatment and coating. The supplier's process plan must match the drawing and contract. Shot peening, setting, crack examination and fatigue validation are not assumed merely because an item is described as a railway spring; specify the required operations and evidence.

Inspection and documentation

Agree dimensional checks, end condition and load-deflection measurement points before quotation. If matched groups are required, define the grouping and identification rules. State any material evidence, surface examination, fatigue qualification or purchaser witness requirements separately. Release records should identify the delivered batch and the approved acceptance baseline.

Packaging and shipment

Separate coated contact surfaces to prevent transit damage, protect identification and keep matched groups traceable. Confirm package mass, lifting arrangements, corrosion protection and storage conditions for the destination route.

Request a technical quotation

Send the controlled drawing and revision, vehicle or bogie application, quantity, exact standards and editions, acceptance plan, required documents, packing requirements and destination. Amy Sun will coordinate technical and commercial clarification before a supply commitment. This listing does not confirm stock availability, certification or model interchangeability.

Frequently asked questions

Can a replacement spring be selected from free height alone?

No. Geometry, load-deflection behavior, end conditions, material, installation and the approved suspension arrangement also matter. Provide a controlled drawing and functional specification.

Can Railwheel quote a complete spring group?

Send the spring-group drawing, quantities by position, matching requirements and acceptance plan. The scope and supply feasibility are reviewed before quotation.

Does this listing confirm a particular railway certification?

No. Applicable standards, editions, approvals and required test evidence must be identified in the inquiry and confirmed in the quotation.

China supply and export

Railway suspension spring supply from China

Railwheel, based in Ma'anshan, Anhui, supports overseas procurement with technical clarification and export coordination. Confirm the production facility, supply responsibilities and applicable approval scope in the quotation and contract.

Define the technical scope before comparing quotations

Provide load-deflection points, free and installed heights, spring envelope, end configuration and material requirements. State whether the spring is part of a nested assembly and identify clearance and matching requirements; wire diameter alone is not a sufficient replacement specification.

Agree inspection and shipment acceptance

Confirm fatigue acceptance, dimensional tolerances, load testing, surface treatment and traceability. Any presetting, shot peening or coating requirement must be stated in the agreed manufacturing route rather than assumed from a catalog photograph.

Send the drawing revision, quantity, destination and required delivery window to Amy Sun. Lead time, minimum order quantity and documentation are confirmed individually, not inferred from this listing.
